'''Loth-cats''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] species. They were kept as pets during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR News" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Loth-cats were created for the animated series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', first appearing in the [[2014]] episode "[[Rise of the Old Masters]]."<ref name="Rebels">{{Rebels|Rise of the Old Masters}}</ref> They were introduced to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[2023]], in Game Update 7.3.1 to the massively multiplayer online roleplaying game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR News" />
